name: paladin
lore:
A Paladin is a singular entity, a mortal vessel forged into a conduit for the divine. They do not merely inhabit the world; they seek to refine it. Ecologically, they are found where the friction between light and shadow is most volatile—guarding the thresholds of hallowed sites or standing as unyielding bulwarks against the encroaching tides of the Abyss.

Behaviorally, they are governed by the Oath, a metaphysical anchor that transmutes raw conviction into tangible power. This manifests as a literal aura, a perceptible weight of presence that bolsters allies and chills the blood of the wicked. While a warrior fights for gold or glory, the Paladin fights because their soul demands it. To witness a Paladin in battle is to see the heavens’ judgment rendered in steel and searing radiance. They are the apex protectors of the moral order, as disciplined as they are dangerous.
